definitionZh: :is() CSS 伪类函数将一个选择器列表作为其参数,并选择该列表中一个选择器可以选择的任何元素. 这对于以更紧凑的形式写大选择器是有用的.
sourceDefinition: The :is() CSS pseudo-class function takes a selector list as its argument, and selects any element that can be selected by one of the selectors in that list. This is useful for writing large selectors in a more compact form.
